venue.details: Speedcubing exhibit at Arnold Sports Festival Australia 2018

information: It will be noisy. Please bring earmuffs/plugs if you are easily distracted. Max 80 competitors. The competitor registration fee includes access to the expo. Spectators will need to purchase tickets from https://arnoldsportsfestival.com.au to enter the expo.
